name: First Mover
summary: Settles which pool owns a token symbol by trading volume rather than registration order

contracts.name: EthFirstMoverFeeHookV1
contracts.role: Applies the immutable buy and sell fee settings, owns the ticker registry and routes tribute.

contracts.name: EthFirstMoverFeeHookFactoryV1
contracts.role: Deterministically deploys the hook at a valid v4 hook address via CREATE2, mirroring Classic's and Ladder's factory shape.

contracts.name: TickerClaimV1
contracts.role: Pure symbol normalization, claim lifecycle and tribute arithmetic.
